title: Aius carrier - ethernet sheet
description: Native-Ethernet magjack. The DP83825 PHY is on the Teensy 4.1, so its 6-pin
native-Ethernet header carries post-PHY MDI differential pairs straight to the
Pulse J0011D21BNL magjack (integrated 1CT:1 magnetics + Bob-Smith termination).
No PHY, no RMII, no 25 MHz clock on the carrier. See connectivity/nets.md and

design_notes.mdi_mapping: Teensy native-Ethernet header MDI pairs to the magjack PHY-side pins: ETH_TXP->TD+ (pin 1), ETH_TXN->TD- (pin 2), ETH_RXP->RD+ (pin 3), ETH_RXN->RD- (pin 6). The magjack integrated magnetics couple these to the RJ45 cable side.
design_notes.centre_tap_cap: The transmit and receive PHY-side transformer centre taps (pins 4 TCT, 5 RCT) are tied together (ETH_CT) and returned to GND through the single 100nF centre-tap cap C30 - the same decoupling the PJRC Ethernet Kit reference provides for this native connection.
design_notes.led: ETH_LED drives the magjack left green LED anode (pin 9); its cathode (pin 10) returns to GND. The Teensy 4.1 schematic has R3=150 ohms between PHY LED0 and this header signal. J0011D21BNL does not have internal LED resistors; current limiting is on the Teensy. The right yellow LED (pins 11/12) is unused.
design_notes.chassis: Pulse J403.L p5 explicitly connects J0011 pin 8 (CHS GROUND, internal 1nF termination return) to PCB GND. The physical shield tabs SH remain on CHASSIS with the USB shells. CHASSIS is deliberately isolated from digital GND; no implicit layout-only short is allowed.
design_notes.no_phy: No DP83825 and no RMII on the carrier - the PHY is on the Teensy. This is the evidence-backed correction to the original H1b plan; see connectivity/nets.md.

components.desc: CAB-29458 ribbon to Teensy top: 1 RX+, 2 RX-, 3 LED, 4 GND, 5 TX-, 6 TX+; unkeyed, continuity-test all six wires
native-Ethernet RJ45 magjack (integrated magnetics + G/Y LEDs), MDI to Teensy header
Ethernet centre-tap cap: joined TX/RX PHY-side centre taps to GND
